source_article: "SOHR,2018-10-01,Hours after the Iranian strikes…fierce clashes continue between ISIS against SDF at the eastern banks of the Euphrates River";"SOHR,2018-10-02,SDF detain ISIS members of different nationalities in conjunction with violent clashes in its last enclave east of Euphrates following the Iranian strikes that killed several members";"SOHR,2018-10-02,41 people were killed yesterday including 4 members of the regime forces and their allied militiamen, and 31 persons were killed in different circumstances in several Syrian areas";"SOHR,2018-10-04,SDF achieve a new advancement in Al-Susah area within ISIS last enclave in the east of the Euphrates and the ongoing fighting raises to more than 340, the number of fighters who were killed";"SOHR,2018-10-05,The killing of 35 members of ISIS and SDF in the recent 48 hours in the east of the Euphrates raises to about 370, the number of those who were killed in the ranks of both parties in 26 days";"SOHR,2018-10-07,Bombings hit SDF areas east of Euphrates cause casualties in conjunction with continuous clashes against ISIS in its last enclave in the area";"SOHR,2018-10-08,For the first time, the International Coalition warplanes intensify the bombardment on al-Azraq Field area after ISIS members infiltrated it in conjunction with the violent clashes east of Euphrates";"SOHR,2018-10-10,After tens of their members were killed, captured and escaped…SDF start a counterattack in ISIS last enclave with support of heavy firepower by their forces and the International Coalition";"SOHR,2018-10-11,The violent clashes continue at the eastern banks of Euphrates and ISIS loses 18 fighters in a counterattack by SDF on the area";"SOHR,2018-10-13,The 4th day’s fighting continues violently and the Coalition escalates its shelling on the last areas left for the organization in the east of the Euphrates after clashes left hundreds of casualties";"SOHR,2018-10-14,Pace of clashes east of Euphrates decreases and the Coalition transfers ammunition and reinforcements to the perimeter of ISIS enclave and information about its rejection of an offer by ISIS to release the kidnapped people of the camp";"SOHR,2018-10-19,The International Coalition carries out 2 massacres in the recent 24 hours in a town in the east of Deir Ezzor which claimed the lives of 46 citizens and members of the “Islamic State” organization";"SOHR,2018-10-20,The International Coalition’s warplanes escalate their bombardment on ISIS last enclave east of the Euphrates and kill more than 28 members of the organization since yesterday after the midnight";"SOHR,2018-10-22,After they advanced in Al-Susah with the support of the Coalition… violent clashes continue between SDF and ISIS in areas in the east of the Euphrates";"SOHR,2018-10-24,Violent explosions rock the east of the Euphrates along with the ongoing violent clashes between SDF against ISIS";"SOHR,2018-10-25,In conjunction with holding about 300 persons of 130 kidnapped families…the “Islamic State” organization executes 5 persons on charge of “dealing with the SDF” in its last enclave east of the river";"SOHR,2018-10-28,300 fighters of the special forces arrive in the vicinity of the organization’s enclave in the east of the Euphrates and the Coalition carries out a round of aerial and ground shelling leaving more human losses along with the withdrawal of tens of vehicles";"SOHR,2018-11-04,In conjunction with preparations for an attack east of Euphrates, ISIS carries out a violent attack, kills and injures more than 32 SDF members in the area";"SOHR,2018-11-06,More casualties raise to 30, the number of killed ISIS members in the first attacks SDF Special Task Forces at the east bank of Euphrates";"SOHR,2018-11-15,Recovering more victims from under the rubble raises the death toll to 105 including 44 children killed in 7 days of bombing by the International Coalition"

camp;The International Coalition carries out 2 massacres in the recent 24 hours in a town in the east of Deir Ezzor which claimed the lives of 46 citizens and members of the “Islamic State”
